narrative: Expanded dataset documentation with clearer pattern descriptions and target signal notes.
purpose: Complete user request to document dataset patterns and target signals with proper structure.
user_input:
if you look in $HOME/.jgt/settings.json you will find a property "patterns" that determine names and columns it includes.

after you have done that , keep observing what you have in ./data/full/targets/mx or  ./data/full/mx/targets you should find potential signals "fdbb" and "fdbs" with their corresponding  profit or loss in the "target" column.  you should also be capable to find the corresponding dataset under  ./data/full/ttf|mlf|cds 

work on all you find related in : docs/index_purpose_data_columns.md

* In development, data is in ./data/full/ttf ./data/full/mlf ./data/targets/mx
scene: Future analysts quickly trace features to targets using the tidy docs.
